name: Radiology Triage Prioritiser
description: A model that reads chest X-rays as they arrive and reorders the radiologist's worklist so likely-urgent studies are read first. It never issues a diagnosis and never removes a study from the list; a radiologist reads every image regardless of order.
documentation: Processes patient identifiers and images. Hosted in-Kingdom on the hospital's own infrastructure. A DPIA was completed in March 2026 and is on file. Model performance was validated on 4,200 local studies with sensitivity reported by subgroup (age, sex). Radiologists are told the ordering is AI-assisted. Full audit log of every reordering is retained for 3 years.

name: Autonomous Medication Dose Adjuster
description: An agent that changes insulin dosing instructions in the electronic medical record automatically based on glucose sensor trends, without clinician confirmation. Changes take effect immediately and the patient is notified by SMS.
documentation: No clinician approval step exists. Health data including glucose readings and medication history is processed. No DPIA has been completed. No clinical validation study has been run. There is no mechanism for a patient or clinician to contest or roll back a change. Decisions are not logged with the inputs used.

name: Clinic Appointment No-Show Predictor
description: Predicts which booked patients are likely not to attend, so reception can send an extra reminder. Output is only used to trigger a reminder message; no appointment is cancelled or deprioritised.
documentation: Uses appointment history and postcode. Data stays in-Kingdom. No fairness assessment has been performed, and postcode is used as a feature which may correlate with socioeconomic status. Retention is 12 months. Patients are not told a prediction is made about them.

name: Credit Card Fraud Alert Scorer
description: Scores card transactions in real time and holds suspicious ones for a fraud analyst to review within 15 minutes. No transaction is permanently declined by the model alone; an analyst confirms or releases every hold.
documentation: Processes transaction and cardholder data in-Kingdom. Model is monitored weekly for drift with documented thresholds. Analysts see the top contributing features for each hold. A customer can call to have a hold released immediately. Annual bias review across customer segments is documented.

name: Automated Mortgage Rejection Engine
description: Declines mortgage applications automatically below a model score threshold. Declined applicants receive a form letter with no reason. There is no appeal route and no human review of declines.
documentation: Features include age, marital status, nationality and district of residence. No fairness or disparate-impact testing has been performed. No DPIA. No model card. Feature values used for a decision are not retained, so a decision cannot be reconstructed or contested.

name: Branch Queue Forecaster
description: Forecasts hourly branch footfall from historical aggregate counts so staffing rotas can be planned a week ahead. Uses only aggregated, non-identifiable counts per branch per hour.
documentation: No personal data is processed; inputs are aggregate counts with no customer identifiers. Hosted in-Kingdom. A manager approves each published rota. Retention 24 months of aggregates.

name: Offshore Customer Call Transcription
description: Sends recorded customer service calls to an overseas speech-to-text vendor for transcription and quality scoring. Recordings contain customer names, account numbers and occasionally health information mentioned in passing.
documentation: Audio is uploaded to the vendor's servers in Germany and Singapore. No transfer impact assessment has been recorded and no adequacy or SDAIA/PDPL approval has been sought. The vendor's standard terms allow retention of audio for model improvement; the bank has not opted out. Customers hear a generic 'calls may be recorded' notice that does not mention transfer abroad or model training.

name: Citizen Enquiry Router
description: Classifies incoming citizen enquiries by topic and routes them to the correct department inbox. The text is read by a human officer in every case; the model only chooses the inbox.
documentation: Enquiries may contain names and national IDs. Processing is in-Kingdom on government cloud. Misroutes are corrected by officers and logged. A privacy notice tells citizens that automated routing is used. Retention follows the records schedule of 5 years. No decision about the citizen is made by the model.

name: Benefits Eligibility Auto-Decider
description: Determines social benefit eligibility and terminates payments automatically when the model predicts ineligibility. No caseworker reviews a termination before it takes effect.
documentation: Uses income records, household composition and employment history. Terminations take effect immediately with a generic notice. There is no caseworker review and no documented appeal process. No DPIA and no fairness testing. The model was trained on five-year-old historical decisions whose correctness was never audited.

name: Public Consultation Summariser
description: Summarises published public consultation responses into themes for a policy team. All inputs are already published on the government website with consent for publication.
documentation: Inputs are already-public consultation submissions. Summaries are checked by a policy officer before use. Processing is in-Kingdom. The published report states that AI assisted the thematic summarisation. No personal data beyond what respondents chose to publish.

name: Municipal Permit Document Checker
description: Checks uploaded building permit documents for completeness against a checklist and tells the applicant which documents are missing. It does not approve or reject permits.
documentation: Processes commercial documents and applicant contact details, in-Kingdom. An officer makes every permit decision. Applicants are told an automated completeness check runs first. Accuracy of the completeness check was measured at 93% on 500 historical applications. Audit log retained 7 years.

name: CV Shortlisting Ranker
description: Ranks job applicants' CVs and presents the top 20 to recruiters. Applicants below the cut are not shown to any human and receive an automated rejection.
documentation: Trained on ten years of historical hiring decisions. No adverse-impact analysis by gender or nationality has been performed. Applicants are not told that ranking is automated. Rejected candidates below the cut are never seen by a recruiter. No DPIA.

name: Internal Job Recommendation Feed
description: Suggests internal vacancies to employees based on their own stated skills and the job descriptions. Employees opt in, can see why a role was suggested, and applying is entirely their choice.
documentation: Opt-in only; employees can turn it off. Uses self-declared skills, not performance data. No decision about the employee is made and no manager sees the recommendations. Explanation shown for each suggestion. In-Kingdom hosting. Retention until opt-out.

name: Continuous Productivity Scorer
description: Scores employee productivity continuously from keystroke counts, application usage and webcam presence detection, and feeds the score into performance reviews and termination decisions.
documentation: Monitors keystrokes and uses webcam presence detection throughout the working day. Employees were not consulted and cannot opt out. Scores feed performance and termination decisions. No DPIA, no proportionality assessment, no fairness testing. Employees cannot see or contest their score.

name: Payroll Anomaly Flagger
description: Flags payroll runs whose totals deviate from expectation so a payroll officer can check before payment is released. Flags only; never blocks or alters a payment.
documentation: Uses aggregate payroll totals and per-department sums, in-Kingdom. A payroll officer reviews every flag and releases payment. No individual employee decision is made. Audit trail of flags retained 7 years. Threshold logic is documented.

name: Automated Exam Essay Grader
description: Assigns final grades to university entrance essays with no human marker involved. The grade is final and there is no re-mark route.
documentation: No human marker reviews any essay. No re-mark or appeal process exists. Agreement with human markers was measured once at 0.61 correlation and not since. No fairness analysis across first-language groups. Students are not told grading is fully automated.

name: Study Material Recommender
description: Recommends optional practice exercises to students based on which topics they have completed. Recommendations carry no grade consequence and students can ignore them.
documentation: Uses only course progress data, no assessment outcomes. No grading impact. Students are told recommendations are automated and can dismiss them. In-Kingdom hosting. Retention one academic year.

name: Remote Exam Proctoring Flagger
description: Watches students' webcams during remote exams and flags suspected cheating behaviour for academic integrity review. Flagged students face a hearing; the model's flag is the main evidence presented.
documentation: Processes video and biometric gaze data of students in their homes. No DPIA. No accuracy or false-positive rate has been measured. No analysis of whether flag rates differ by skin tone or disability. Students must consent to sit the exam, so consent is not freely given. A human panel reviews flags but is given no false-positive rate to weigh them against.

name: Library Catalogue Semantic Search
description: Improves search over the university's public library catalogue using semantic matching on titles and abstracts. No user profile is built and queries are not linked to individuals.
documentation: Indexes only public bibliographic metadata. Queries are not logged against user identity. No personal data processed. In-Kingdom hosting.

name: Published FAQ Answer Bot
description: Answers customer questions using only the company's published help-centre articles, and links the article it used. Escalates to a human whenever it has no matching article.
documentation: Knowledge base is the already-public help centre. No customer personal data is used to generate answers. The bot states it is automated and offers a human handover on every turn. Conversations are stored without identifiers for 30 days for quality review. In-Kingdom hosting.

name: Autonomous Refund Approver
description: Approves or refuses refund requests up to SAR 5,000 automatically with no human review, including refusals on suspected-abuse grounds.
documentation: Refusals are final within the automated channel and the customer is given a generic reason. There is no documented appeal path. Uses purchase history and a behavioural abuse score whose features are undocumented. No fairness review. No DPIA.

name: Support Ticket Sentiment Tagger
description: Tags incoming support tickets as positive, neutral or negative so managers can spot unhappy customers. Tags are advisory and do not change ticket priority automatically.
documentation: Processes ticket text which may contain customer names. In-Kingdom. Tags are advisory only; agents can override and no routing changes automatically. Retention 90 days. Customers are told in the privacy notice that tickets are analysed automatically.

name: Voice Cloning for IVR Greetings
description: Clones a named voice actor's voice to generate new IVR greetings without re-recording sessions. The cloned voice is presented to callers as a human agent's voice.
documentation: The voice actor signed a general recording release five years ago that does not mention synthetic voice cloning. Callers are not told the voice is synthetic. No watermarking or disclosure of synthetic audio. No consent refresh was sought.

name: Phishing Email Classifier
description: Classifies inbound email as phishing and quarantines it for a security analyst to release. Users can request a release and an analyst decides within an hour.
documentation: Processes employee email metadata and body text, in-Kingdom. False-positive rate measured monthly and reported at 0.4%. Release path documented and staffed. Audit log of quarantines retained 2 years. Employees informed via the acceptable use policy.

name: Autonomous Endpoint Isolation Agent
description: Detects suspected compromise and disconnects the affected employee endpoint from the network automatically, with no analyst confirmation, including on production servers.
documentation: Acts without analyst confirmation and can isolate production servers. No documented rollback procedure and no blast-radius limit. False-positive rate has not been measured. No change-management or abort mechanism. Isolation events are logged but not reviewed.

name: Vulnerability Report Prioritiser
description: Orders the vulnerability backlog by exploitability so engineers fix the riskiest first. Only reorders a backlog; engineers decide what to fix.
documentation: Uses internal scanner output and public CVE data. No personal data. In-Kingdom. Engineers review and can reorder. Ranking rationale shown per item. No automated remediation.

name: Insider Threat Behaviour Profiler
description: Builds a continuous risk profile of every employee from file access, email and badge-in data, and escalates high scorers to HR investigation.
documentation: Profiles all employees continuously without their knowledge. Escalations trigger HR investigation. No DPIA, no proportionality assessment. Employees cannot see or contest their score. No fairness testing on escalation rates by nationality or role.

name: Shelf Stock Gap Detector
description: Uses ceiling cameras pointed at shelves to spot empty shelf space and alert staff to restock. Cameras are framed on shelves only and faces are blurred at capture.
documentation: Cameras are framed at shelf level; on-device face blurring is applied before any frame is stored. No customer identification and no biometric matching. In-Kingdom processing. Signage informs customers cameras operate for stock management. Frames retained 24 hours.

name: In-Store Face Recognition Blacklist
description: Matches every entering shopper's face against a store-built list of suspected shoplifters and alerts security to approach them.
documentation: Biometric matching of all entering shoppers against an internally compiled suspect list. No judicial or regulatory basis for the list. No consent obtained. No DPIA. No measured false-match rate, and no analysis of whether false matches differ across demographics. No route for a person to know they are listed or to be removed.

name: Demand Forecast for Reordering
description: Forecasts SKU-level demand from historical sales to generate purchase order suggestions a buyer approves.
documentation: Uses aggregate SKU sales with no customer identifiers. A buyer approves every purchase order. In-Kingdom. Forecast error tracked monthly. No personal data.

name: Personalised Dynamic Pricing
description: Sets a different price for the same product per shopper based on inferred willingness to pay, including device type, browsing history and inferred income bracket.
documentation: Infers income bracket from postcode and device. Shoppers are not told prices are personalised. No fairness assessment on whether protected groups systematically pay more. No DPIA. No opt-out.

name: Weld Defect Visual Inspector
description: Inspects weld images on the line and diverts suspect parts to a manual inspection station. A human inspector makes the scrap decision.
documentation: Images of parts only; no personal data. In-Kingdom. Validated at 98.1% recall on a 3,000-image held-out set; performance monitored weekly. Human inspector decides scrap or rework. Full traceability per part retained 10 years.

name: Autonomous Furnace Setpoint Controller
description: Adjusts furnace temperature setpoints autonomously to optimise yield, with authority to move outside the documented safe operating envelope if the model predicts a yield gain.
documentation: The agent may exceed the documented safe operating envelope. No hard interlock or engineering override was implemented. No safety case or HAZOP review was performed for autonomous operation. No abort path documented. Operators are not alerted to setpoint changes.

name: Predictive Maintenance Scheduler
description: Predicts bearing failure from vibration sensors and raises a maintenance work order for a planner to schedule.
documentation: Sensor data only, no personal data. In-Kingdom. A planner approves each work order. Model precision and recall tracked quarterly and documented. No autonomous plant action.

name: Traffic Signal Timing Optimiser
description: Adjusts traffic light timings from inductive loop vehicle counts to reduce congestion, within timing bounds set by traffic engineers.
documentation: Uses anonymous vehicle counts from inductive loops; no cameras, no plates, no personal data. Operates strictly within engineer-set timing bounds with a hard fallback to fixed timings. In-Kingdom. Engineers review weekly.

name: Public Space Crowd Face Analytics
description: Analyses public square camera feeds to estimate crowd demographics by age, gender and ethnicity for urban planning reports.
documentation: Infers ethnicity, age and gender from faces of members of the public in public spaces. No consent is obtained and no signage exists. No DPIA. No accuracy assessment of the demographic inference, which is known to be unreliable across groups. No retention limit defined.

name: Waste Collection Route Planner
description: Plans refuse truck routes from bin fill-level sensors to cut mileage. Route plans are approved by a depot supervisor each morning.
documentation: Bin sensor fill levels and road network data only. No personal data. In-Kingdom. Supervisor approves each day's routes. No decision about any individual.

name: Predictive Policing Patrol Allocator
description: Predicts which neighbourhoods will see crime and directs police patrol allocation accordingly, using historical arrest records.
documentation: Trained on historical arrest data, which reflects past enforcement patterns rather than crime incidence. No assessment of feedback loops or of disparate impact on particular neighbourhoods. No DPIA. No community consultation. No mechanism to audit whether predictions became self-fulfilling.

name: Meeting Action Item Extractor
description: Extracts action items from internal meeting notes that employees paste in. The note author reviews and edits the extracted list before circulating it.
documentation: Internal notes only, authored by employees; colleague names may appear. In-Kingdom hosting. Author reviews and edits every output before it goes anywhere. No writes to any system of record. Retention 90 days. SSO-restricted to the team.

name: Code Review Assistant
description: Comments on internal pull requests suggesting improvements. Engineers accept or ignore suggestions; the assistant cannot merge or approve.
documentation: Proprietary source code is sent to a commercial model API under a signed enterprise agreement with no-training terms confirmed in writing. Cannot merge or approve. In-Kingdom gateway with the vendor's regional endpoint. Data handling reviewed by security. Suggestions logged for 30 days.

name: Unvetted Shadow AI Document Summariser
description: Employees paste internal documents, including unreleased financial results and HR files, into a free public chatbot to summarise them. Adopted informally with no review.
documentation: No contract, no data processing agreement and no security review exist. The free tier's terms permit using submitted content for model training. Confidential and personal data including HR files has already been pasted in. No inventory of what was shared. No approval was sought.

name: Internal Wiki Semantic Search
description: Semantic search across the internal wiki, respecting each page's existing access permissions so results never reveal pages a user cannot already open.
documentation: Index respects source page ACLs and was tested for permission leakage. In-Kingdom. No personal data beyond author names. No decisions made. Query logs anonymised after 7 days.

name: Global HR Analytics Warehouse
description: Replicates all Saudi employee HR records to a group analytics warehouse in Ireland for workforce reporting across the international group.
documentation: Full employee records including salary, nationality, performance ratings and health absence reasons are replicated to Ireland. No transfer impact assessment and no SDAIA/PDPL transfer approval. Employees were not notified of the transfer. No data minimisation was applied before replication.

name: Regional Chatbot with In-Kingdom Residency
description: A customer chatbot serving several Gulf markets where each market's conversation data is pinned to in-country storage and never leaves its jurisdiction.
documentation: Data residency enforced per market with Saudi data stored in-Kingdom only; verified by an architecture review and an annual audit. A signed data processing agreement is in place with the model vendor including no-training terms. Customers are told they are talking to an automated assistant and can reach a human. Retention 60 days.

name: Offshore Model Fine-Tuning on Customer Chats
description: Exports two years of Saudi customer chat transcripts to a US affiliate to fine-tune a shared model used across all group markets.
documentation: Transcripts contain names, phone numbers and order details. Exported to the United States. No transfer impact assessment, no adequacy basis and no regulator approval. Customers never consented to their conversations being used for model training. No de-identification was applied before export.

name: Consent-Based Marketing Segmenter
description: Segments customers for marketing emails using only data from customers who gave explicit marketing consent, with one-click withdrawal honoured immediately.
documentation: Explicit opt-in consent recorded per customer with timestamp and scope. Withdrawal honoured within minutes and tested. Only purchase history and stated preferences used; no inferred sensitive attributes. In-Kingdom. DPIA completed and on file. Retention tied to consent.

name: Health Inference from Shopping Baskets
description: Infers likely pregnancy and chronic health conditions from grocery purchase patterns to target promotions.
documentation: Derives health and pregnancy status, which are sensitive categories, from non-health data. Customers consented only to general loyalty analytics, not health inference. No DPIA. No accuracy measurement of the inference. Promotions revealing an inferred pregnancy have already been sent to shared household addresses.

name: Open Data Portal Chat Interface
description: A chat interface over the government open data portal that answers questions using only published open datasets and cites the dataset used.
documentation: Only already-published open datasets are indexed. No personal data. Every answer cites the dataset and links it. Users are told answers are generated. In-Kingdom. No profiling of users.

name: Autonomous Drone Delivery Route Authoriser
description: Authorises and dispatches delivery drone flights over populated urban areas autonomously, choosing routes without a human dispatcher approving each flight.
documentation: Flights over populated areas are authorised without human approval. No aviation regulator approval has been obtained for autonomous authorisation. No documented safety case, no geofencing of sensitive sites, and no emergency abort procedure. Third-party injury risk has not been assessed.

name: Internal Cafeteria Menu Translator
description: Translates the staff cafeteria's daily menu from Arabic to English for the internal noticeboard. A facilities coordinator proofreads each translation.
documentation: Menu text only. No personal data of any kind. A coordinator proofreads before posting. In-Kingdom. No decision about any person. Nothing retained beyond the current day's menu.
